incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — inference-api (eu-west-1) 5xx rate spike (>3% p95) — paging oncall
sara-ong: ack oncall here, joining bridge
mike_zhao: on it, checking recent deploys and autoscaler logs
sara-ong: looks like KV cache evictions spiked + a couple pods OOMed, might be cascading when shard recovery happens
jordan: I can shift some traffic to dedicated-pool-b while we stabilize, hold for sara
sara-ong: do it now
jordan: routing rule updated — redirecting 30% -> dedicated-pool-b :white_check_mark:
deepa: logs show model-shard OOMs coming from quantized runner after the runtime build, reproducing locally
kevin: rolled back runtime v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 across eu-west-1, watching metrics
incidents-bot: AUTO: paging suppressed for duplicate alerts (5min) to reduce noise
sara-ong: p95 and error rate coming down, starting quick debrief in 10
mike_zhao: assigning followups: 1) root-cause: investigate KV eviction pattern (deepa) 2) alert tuning: increase aggregation window (kevin) 3) postmortem owner (sara)
deepa: will collect heap snapshots + eviction traces, ETA EOD tomorrow
kevin: proposal for alert change:
```
alert: inference_api_5xx_high
expr: rate(http_requests_total{job="inference-api",code=~"5.."}[2m]) > 0.02
for: 5m
labels: { severity: "page" }
```
Change suggestion: extend `for` from 5m -> 10m and add a short burst_suppression window to avoid paging on transient bursts
sara-ong: +1, also add route_owner label so oncall sees which pool is impacted in the alert payload
jordan: scheduling postmortem Tue 10:00 in #incidents-retro, sara to create doc and invite stakeholders
sara-ong: filed postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/example/postmortem-2501239876 :spiral_note_pad:
kevin: opening alert-groom PR, will add SLO targets: 99.9% availability per region and rules to suppress <30s bursts
deepa: followups noted: kv-metrics dashboard (deepa), rollback/playbook update (jordan), autoscaler threshold audit (mike)
sara-ong: closing bridge, will monitor for 1h. Re-open if symptoms recur. great teamwork :heart:
incidents-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED — duration 00:18:20 — postmortem scheduled
